messages:
incident-bot: Pager P1 — sudden spike in 5xx for /v1/generate (model=redwood-v3-opt-quant). Alert threshold crossed: 2m error rate 18%. https://metrics.internal/r/alerts/1879991234
Kai: on it, I'm awake. grabbing quick signal from prod logs
Marta: I saw this on the perf dashboard, looks like the quantized variant is throwing decode OOM in some pods.
Ben: tagging @oncall-sre for pager handover if needed, what's the blast radius?
Anna: top 3 affected keys: key-abc (35%), key-xyz (18%), key-ops (12%). A few enterprise customers showing user-facing failures.
Kai: runbook step 2 — temporary mitigation = evict variant from routing and route to safe fallback (redwood-v3-base-fp16). Doing dry-run now
Anna: prepare comms for SRE/Support, I'm pulling incident impact stats.
Kai: dry-run result: routing table mutation looks fine. issuing emergency evict now:
```
# internal CLI
rwdctl route modify --model redwood-v3-opt-quant --action disable --reason "elevated 5xx" --force
```
incident-bot: Action recorded: variant disable requested by Kai at 2026-11-02T02:12:14Z.
Marta: Confirming traffic shift; backend logs show fallback model receiving requests. 5xx rate dropping to 2.1% after shift.
Ben: throttling heavy keys as a precaution (10% throttle on key-abc) to reduce retry storms.
Anna: customer impact: estimated 0.9% of active users experienced errors between 02:05-02:12 UTC. Key-abc had retries — flagged for CS reachout.
Jorge: I'll take over the on-call handoff in 10m. any open actions?
Kai: open actions: 1) keep variant disabled, 2) monitor error rate for 30m, 3) create postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime, 4) notify affected customers.
Anna: creating INC ticket and slack thread for postmortem: INC-2026-789. Added initial notes and sample logs.
Ben: added temporary quota adjustment: lowered per-key burst for noisy keys to 50 rps via config push.
oncall-sre: taking oncall now — will monitor and coordinate with runtime team. I'm enabling alert suppression for repeated noisy keys so we don't re-pager while we stabilize.
Jorge: during handoff: current severity P1 -> mitigated. Variant remains disabled. Monitoring window 30m. If errors <1% after window, we'll keep disabled and schedule rollback/analysis.
Marta: note — we saw an anomalous model load pattern that coincided with a new quantization kernel selection. Queueing a rollback of that kernel on the staging cluster for repro.
Anna: Customer comms draft: "We experienced a transient increase in errors affecting some requests due to a problem with an optimized model build. We've routed traffic to a stable model and are monitoring. If you saw errors, please open a ticket and quote INC-2026-789." Sending to #customer-ops to approve. :email:
Kai: thanks all. leaving the thread for Jorge/oncall-sre. I'll follow up with runtime patch if we reproduce.
Jorge: acknowledged. if anything spikes I'll @Kai and escalate. closing pager for now but keeping thread open for postmortem notes."
